title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin holds sixty-four thousand sixty dollars, down one point four percent in twenty-four hours as fear and greed hits twenty-five in extreme fear territory. US morning session shows steady selling pressure with no volume breakout yet. On-chain, the network stays robust at eight hundred fifty-two exahashes per second hashrate while the mempool backs up to one hundred eleven thousand transactions at a cheap five sat per vbyte fee floor. Block height now nine hundred fifty-eight thousand three h
